title: CSV issue import and export
summary: File intake, mapping, nonmutating preview, explicit confirmation, deduplicated import and bounded filtered export. Related test references do not certify per-case coverage or execution.

cases.title: Open project transfer
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Open Import and export in an active writable project.
expected: Project-scoped import and export controls appear.

cases.title: View read-only transfer
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Open the page as a viewer.
expected: Export is available and import has a read-only role explanation.

cases.title: Explain archived import denial
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Open the page for an archived project.
expected: The page asks for restoration before importing.

cases.title: Choose CSV file
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Choose a valid nonempty UTF-8 CSV.
expected: Filename and heading list appear for mapping.

cases.title: Drop CSV file
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Drop a valid CSV on the file target.
expected: The same intake and mapping flow starts.

cases.title: Reject empty file
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Choose an empty file.
expected: The page requires a nonempty UTF-8 CSV.

cases.title: Reject oversized file
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Choose a CSV larger than one MiB.
expected: The file is rejected before preview.

cases.title: Reject invalid UTF-8
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Choose bytes that cannot decode as UTF-8.
expected: The page explains preserving Arabic and other text using UTF-8.

cases.title: Accept UTF-8 BOM
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview a valid CSV beginning with BOM.
expected: The first heading is recognized without BOM.

cases.title: Preserve quoted CSV cells
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview quoted commas and embedded newlines.
expected: Fields retain their intended values.

cases.title: Require valid headings
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview content without a valid header row.
expected: Header validation rejects the file.

cases.title: Require data rows
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview a header-only file.
expected: Validation requires at least one data row.

cases.title: Bound headings
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview more than 30 columns.
expected: The parser rejects the file.

cases.title: Reject blank headings
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview a blank or whitespace-only heading.
expected: The parser rejects ambiguous empty headings.

cases.title: Reject duplicate headings
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview duplicate headings after trimming/case normalization.
expected: The file is rejected.

cases.title: Reject malformed quoting
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview an unbalanced quoted row.
expected: The file is rejected with row syntax validation.

cases.title: Reject inconsistent row width
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview a row with a different field count.
expected: The parser rejects the inconsistent row.

cases.title: Bound data rows
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview more than 100 data rows.
expected: The parser rejects an unbounded batch.

cases.title: Map recognized headings
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Leave recognized Title/Summary and optional headings on Automatic.
expected: Recognized aliases map to supported fields.

cases.title: Map custom heading
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Select an explicit nonstandard heading for a field.
expected: Preview reads that selected column.

cases.title: Skip optional column
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Pass the optional skip mapping marker through the API.
expected: The optional field is not mapped.

cases.title: Reject missing selected heading
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Map a field to a heading absent from the CSV.
expected: A mapping validation error is returned.
notes: The public CSV page fixes its route project and offers only headings parsed from the selected file. This hostile raw input is a REST/MCP service boundary, not an available browser control.

cases.title: Require title mapping
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview without a mapped Title or Summary.
expected: Preview is rejected with a required mapping explanation.

cases.title: Read every preview row
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Choose Preview import.
expected: Row numbers, titles, source keys, field errors and valid/error totals are displayed.
notes: Surface correction: browser interaction assertions remain on this stable ID. The distinct service contract is tracked by UC-CSV-0071.

cases.title: Keep preview nonmutating
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview valid rows without confirming import.
expected: No issue is created by preview.

cases.title: Resolve custom type key
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview a configured active standard-type key.
expected: Canonical project type is resolved.

cases.title: Resolve scoped choice UUID
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview an active type, priority or stage ID in the project.
expected: The exact scoped choice resolves.

cases.title: Resolve unique choice name
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview a unique configured display name.
expected: Exactly one scoped choice resolves.

cases.title: Reject ambiguous choice name
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview a choice name matching several eligible records.
expected: The row reports ambiguity rather than selecting arbitrarily.

cases.title: Reject unavailable choice
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview a retired-for-new-use, unknown or foreign choice.
expected: The row receives a scoped choice error.

cases.title: Reject imported subtask type
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Select a subtask behavior without an owning parent flow.
expected: The row instructs importing standard work first and adding subtasks through a parent.

cases.title: Resolve eligible assignee
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview a unique eligible teammate name, email or ID.
expected: The intended eligible person resolves.

cases.title: Reject ambiguous assignee
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview a shared teammate display name.
expected: The row reports ambiguity.

cases.title: Reject ineligible assignee
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview a disabled or otherwise ineligible person.
expected: The row reports an assignee error.

cases.title: Validate calendar date
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview an impossible or malformed due date.
expected: The row receives due-date validation.

cases.title: Map semicolon labels
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview semicolon-separated labels.
expected: Valid labels are prepared without losing supported text.

cases.title: Reject long source identity
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview a source key exceeding 200 characters.
expected: The row receives source-key validation.

cases.title: Reject repeated source in batch
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview two rows using the same nonempty source key.
expected: The duplicate row points to its earlier source-key row.

cases.title: Decode exported source identity
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview a valid export sourceKeyEncoding value.
expected: The original source identity is decoded for deduplication.

cases.title: Reject unsupported source encoding
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview an unsupported or malformed encoded source identity.
expected: The row reports source identity validation.

cases.title: Preserve Arabic transfer values
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview and import Arabic titles, descriptions and labels.
expected: Unicode content survives mapping and issue reads.

cases.title: Sanitize HTML import
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Import HTML-format description containing unsupported markup.
expected: Shared creation sanitation produces retained safe description content.

cases.title: Invalidate preview after mapping edit
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Change the mapping after preview.
expected: Old preview and confirmation are cleared.

cases.title: Invalidate preview after file replacement
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Choose another CSV after preview.
expected: The old file preview/result/confirmation cannot be reused.

cases.title: Require explicit import confirmation
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Preview valid rows without checking review confirmation.
expected: Import valid rows stays disabled.

cases.title: Start a new corrected import
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Choose Start a new import after reviewing row errors.
expected: The previous locked payload, result and confirmation reset.

cases.title: Restore tab-local import draft
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Leave and return within the same signed-in browser tab.
expected: The project-specific draft returns and must be previewed again.

cases.title: Clear import draft on session end
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Sign out or reload with a held draft.
expected: The in-memory draft is not restored into a different session.

cases.title: Discard obsolete project transfer reply
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Switch project/session before delayed preview/export completes.
expected: Old results cannot replace another project or account state.

cases.title: Open imported issues
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Follow View imported issues after import.
expected: The correct project active/backlog issue view opens.

cases.title: Import confirmed valid rows
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Confirm preview and start import.
expected: Every row returns created/existing/failed with counts and issue links.

cases.title: Import into backlog
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Select backlog as destination and import.
expected: Created work is planned rather than active on the board.

cases.title: Deduplicate stable source identity
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Import an already used stable source key in another batch.
expected: The existing issue is returned without duplicate creation.

cases.title: Retain source-less retry identity
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Retry rows without supplied source key using the same batch ID.
expected: Batch and row identities reuse the original accepted work.

cases.title: Preserve successful rows after partial failure
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Import a batch with some failing rows.
expected: Successful rows remain created and each failed row remains identified.

cases.title: Retry original uncertain import
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Repeat frozen original payload, batch and retry reference after temporary failure.
expected: Accepted rows are reused and recoverable rows can resume.

cases.title: Reject archived project import
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Call import_issues for archived project work.
expected: Current authorization rejects creating work until restoration.
notes: This row explicitly calls import_issues on an archived project, a service-only hostile request. The real browser hides import controls on archived projects, separately exercised by UC-CSV-0003.

cases.title: Read accepted-value guidance
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Expand Accepted values and repeat imports.
expected: Source identity/format help appears, but fixed task/bug and low/medium/high wording is stale against canonical choices.

cases.title: Export all current work
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Choose All current work then export.
expected: Every authorized matching current issue is included.

cases.title: Export active work
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Choose Active board then export.
expected: Only matching active-view work is included.

cases.title: Export backlog
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Choose Backlog then export.
expected: Only matching planned work is included.

cases.title: Export archived work
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Choose Archived work then export.
expected: Retained matching archived issues are included with current read permission.

cases.title: Filter exported key/title
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Enter key/title query then export.
expected: The server filters matching issues before export pages are returned.

cases.title: Collect every export page
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Export results spanning several server pages.
expected: The browser combines all rows with one heading row and accurate progress.
notes: Surface correction: browser interaction assertions remain on this stable ID. The distinct service contract is tracked by UC-CSV-0072.

cases.title: Protect spreadsheet formulas
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Export text beginning with formula triggers.
expected: Formula-safe cells preserve data without executing spreadsheet formulas.

cases.title: Reject cross-project export filters
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Pass filters selecting multiple or another project.
expected: The export requires one current authorized project.
notes: The public CSV page fixes its route project and offers only headings parsed from the selected file. This hostile raw input is a REST/MCP service boundary, not an available browser control.

cases.title: Bound export page bytes
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Request a page whose descriptions exceed one MiB.
expected: The service asks for a smaller page.

cases.title: Enforce current transfer permission
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Remove role access before import/export request.
expected: Current service authorization rejects operations no longer allowed.

cases.title: Cancel export preparation
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Choose Cancel export while pages load.
expected: Preparation stops and no partial file is presented as a completed download.

cases.title: Round-trip supported export values
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Export then preview/reimport supported descriptions, choices, Arabic and encoded source keys.
expected: Supported values/source identity remain and existing source work is not duplicated.

cases.title: Return complete typed import preview rows
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Call preview_issue_import for a multirow CSV containing valid and invalid rows.
expected: Every row includes its number, title, source key and field errors, with exact valid/error totals.
notes: Atomic service counterpart split from UC-CSV-0024; it does not claim browser rendering, form state, session epochs or download assembly.

cases.title: Continue bounded CSV export pages
preconditions: The actor has the stated project role; imports target an active project and exports require current read access unless the scenario says otherwise.
steps: Request an export limit smaller than the matching issue set and continue its cursor until exhausted.
expected: Every matching issue is represented once across bounded pages with a consistent total; the terminal page has no next cursor.
notes: Atomic service counterpart split from UC-CSV-0064; it does not claim browser rendering, form state, session epochs or download assembly.
